items.rationale: A1/A2: Clătite clears the usor recognition and Romanian relevance floor through independent current and historical signals: Radio România Internațional reports the 23rd edition of a Romanian clătite festival, with about 15,000 visitors and 20,000 portions in the prior edition, and says the dish is found throughout Romania and in restaurant/pension menus; current PRO TV programming uses unqualified clătite in a national culinary segment; a 2014 Romanian school worksheet is headed CLĂTITE CU GEM; DLRLC recorded the dish noun in 1955–1957. A3/A4: the description honestly states thin cooked batter sheets with sweet or savory fillings. Fresh RRI sources give flour, egg and milk batter, pan cooking, and jam, chocolate, mushroom, onion and meat variants; the independent factual screen inspected all nine incoming non-distractor associations and found no contradiction. A5: no adult, alcohol-dependent, insensitive or owner-only boundary is triggered. A6: no approved Contexto row or reserve entry uses this target; two Conexiuni appearances are a different mechanic, and the earlier V75/V78 raw drops are diagnostic history rather than served duplicates. A7: flour/egg ingredient and jam/dessert/pastry associations are specific culinary relations, not generic regional links. C1: a concrete, spontaneously nameable dish. C2: the multi-source national, school and historical evidence supports the easy recognition band. C3: the lint-clean dossier has nine incoming neighbors, with at least eight plainly recognizable strong ones: Făină, Desert, Papanași, Ou, Înghețată, Dulceață, Plăcinte and Gogoși; reachable is 2,288. C4: actual API routes provide several independent whole-player approaches: Făină rank 2, Desert 3, Ou 5, Dulceață 7 and the distinct nonwinning Gem projection 8 are one-hop/Fierbinte; Lapte 40, Smântână 22 and Brânză 30 are two-hop/Cald; even generic Mâncare is rank 12/Cald. C5: clătite can grammatically be the feminine plural participle/adjective of a clăti, but that use normally modifies an expressed or contextually supplied noun; as an isolated concrete plural, the dominant reading is the lexicalized food noun, and all tested singular/plural/inflected food forms resolve exactly. C6: salience 0.7951 is above the 0.60 usor warning floor. Refute-first: Unt, Ulei and Miere remain six hops/rank 1698/Înghețat, Nucă is rank 1699/Înghețat, and ciocolată/aluat are unresolved with poor suggestions. These are real imperfections: oil or butter can be cooking fats, while honey, nut and chocolate are optional fillings. They do not recreate V78's decisive contradiction, where the accepted ordinary Gem filling was frozen while the near-equivalent Dulceață was hot. V79 now gives Gem direct, nonwinning rank-8 feedback, and the target has multiple independent ingredient, category, dairy and filling routes. On the exact current graph, the remaining cold or zero-cost unknown paths do not defeat C3/C4 or make the easy target unfair. Promote on merit without a quota; this is not a human-enjoyment claim.
